title: Azure for .NET Overview
description: Understand what Azure offers .NET developers and how to prepare your local environment.
longDescription: This module introduces Azure from a .NET developer's perspective. You will learn the main Azure service categories, create a free Azure account, install the Azure SDK for .NET, and choose the right Azure service for a new ASP.NET Core project.
whatYouLearn: Explain Azure's value for ASP.NET Core developers
Create and configure a free Azure account
Install the Azure SDK for .NET and Azure CLI
Choose the right Azure service for hosting, storage, and data
